text.tspan: Genuine saving per capita and GDP per capitaUnited Kingdom
GDP, gross domestic product, represents a nation's total income. Genuine Savings = net fixed produced capital
formation and overseas investment + change in natural capital + education expenditure.
Note: This data is measured in international-$ at 1990 prices to account for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
